phone.lead: Enter your WhatsApp number: if it is allowed for the demo, you receive a code to enter it.

code.lead: Enter the code received on WhatsApp: 6 digits then a letter.

actors.lead: Each account signs in with the real one-time code, read here for you; its onboarding and setup then happen on their own. People, pages and addresses are fictitious; online, each account is shared by all visitors.

unavailable.lead: The demo is unavailable for now.

phone.label: WhatsApp number
phone.hint: With the country code, for example +33 6 00 00 00 00.

code.delivery: If this number is allowed, the code arrives on WhatsApp; with no message after a minute, the delivery did not go through.
code.label: Code received on WhatsApp
code.expired: This code has expired: request a new one.
code.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts: try again in {{duration}}.

demoGate.waitOver: You can request a new code.

actors.unreadable: The demo accounts cannot be read for now.
actors.empty: No demo account is offered for now.

demoGate.unavailable: No code can be requested until the demo is back. Try again later.

errors.demo_gate_unavailable: The demo is unavailable for now. Try again later.
errors.demo_gate_code_invalid: Wrong or expired code. Check it, or request a new one.
errors.demo_gate_code_format: The code has 6 digits then a letter.
